properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.enabled
properties.description: Whether managed-code deployment reconciliation is enabled.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.provider
properties.description: Deployment provider selection. The built-in deterministic provider requires the explicit value 'fake'.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.worker
properties.description: Logical identity used when leasing managed-script definitions.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.initial-delay
properties.description: Delay before the first reconciliation tick.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.lease-duration
properties.description: Lease duration requested from the control plane and renewed while provider work is running.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum number of deployments acquired per physical tenant and tick.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.concurrency
properties.description: Maximum number of physical tenants reconciled concurrently.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.queue-capacity
properties.description: Maximum number of queued physical-tenant reconciliation tasks.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.shutdown-timeout
properties.description: Maximum time to wait for in-flight reconciliation during shutdown.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.local-execution-enabled
properties.description: Whether to execute fake-provider managed scripts in local Node.js or Python subprocesses. This trusted-development-only mode is not a sandbox.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.execution-timeout
properties.description: Maximum duration of one trusted local script invocation.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.invocation-concurrency
properties.description: Maximum number of managed-script invocation jobs activated concurrently per Camunda client.
